Package dayplanner

Class DayPlannerUtils

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.DayPlannerUtils
public class DayPlannerUtils extends Object
Contains utility methods for the application class. Contains extra code that is not required for the main functions of the command loop.

    • matchesKeywords

      public static boolean matchesKeywords(String title, String[] keywords)
      Checks if all keywords appear as individual words in the title (case-insensitive, any order).
      Parameters:
      title - The activity title.
      keywords - The search keywords.
      Returns:
      true if all keywords match words in the title, false otherwise.

    • matchesCriteria

      public static boolean matchesCriteria(Activity act, String[] keywords, Time searchStart, Time searchEnd)
      Determines whether an activity satisfies the search criteria.
      Parameters:
      act - The activity to test.
      keywords - Array of title keywords that must all match words in the title, or null to match all.
      searchStart - Minimum start time, or null for open start.
      searchEnd - Maximum end time, or null for open end.
      Returns:
      true if the activity satisfies all given criteria, false otherwise.

    • readTimePeriod

      public static Time[] readTimePeriod()
      Prompts the user for a time period filter and parses the start and end times.
      Returns:
      A two-element array containing { searchStart, searchEnd }.
